payload.text: Pplr's adoption of devbin 0323 (the core carries a Rust CLI's ship). 0323 shipped in devbin v0.1.20 (closed 2026-11-05), which Pplr has vendored since 64794b6, but Pplr's bin/.devbin/cmd/{lock-sync,macos,post-cut} copies are still in the tree. Per 0323, a project deletes them at its next vendor update and declares its ship in config instead: its macOS binaries (pplr, the pplr-contacts sidecar and the prebuilt Pplr Links.app) and one notarytool keychain profile, macos.notary_profile, which hv stores once through devbin's store-creds. That executes decision 29's (4). Done when Pplr cuts a release with no project ship command left, signed, notarised, accepted by Gatekeeper and its formula published. Not started: Pplr fixes nothing until hv schedules it.
